verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say every connector handles incremental syncs automatically with no pipelines to maintain, and they document delete capture, sync modes (soft delete, live, history), and table-level re-syncs, so cursor and state management is handled by the platform. Community reports call syncing very reliable, though one user hit occasional out-of-sync states that needed a full re-sync. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how cursors, state and change detection work per source type (e.g. log-based CDC vs. API cursors), independent hands-on confirmation that only new or changed records move.
